title: Juicy Charred Venezuelan Pepper Skewers
description: A kid-friendly Venezuelan dish featuring mixed peppers, this recipe is vegetarian-friendly and perfect for a weeknight dinner. The spherified peppers add a fun and unique touch to the dish.
instructions: Preheat grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thread mixed bell peppers, red onion, mushrooms, and cherry tomatoes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with salt, black pepper, and lime juice.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the vegetables are tender and lightly charred.
In a small bowl, mix together sodium alginate and water to create a spherification bath.
Once the skewers are cooked, carefully drop each piece into the spherification bath for about 30 seconds to create a sphere shape.
Remove the spherified peppers from the bath with a slotted spoon and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess moisture.
Serve the juicy charred Venezuelan pepper skewers hot, garnished with fresh cilantro or scallions if desired.
